description: (0.5.0) Identity-level revocation and attestation listing (RFC-ACDP-0021 §9). Behavioral.

input.golden: kl-001 (controller did:web:agents.example.com:ci, identity oidc https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com / repo:example/pipeline:ref:refs/heads/main, registry did:web:registry.example.com)

scenarios.name: A — identity removed from the DID document

expected.behavior: New attestation requests for it fail key_not_authorized / identity_not_authorized. Bodies signed earlier stay verifiable as historically authorized.

scenarios.name: B — publish after the identity was removed, inside a live attestation window

expected.behavior: A registry that re-checks (SHOULD) refuses with key_not_authorized / identity_not_authorized; one that does not accepts, and consumers report historically authorized.
Lists every attestation minted for the controller (and identity, when given), newest first, paginated with next_cursor; each item has ctx_id, content_hash and metadata.
The controller publishes one RFC-ACDP-0014 key-revocation per attested fingerprint whose window ends after T, signed by a DID-document key; consumers place bodies by receipt as in kl-005 C/D.

scenarios.name: E — registry retracts an attestation by policy

expected.behavior: An RFC-ACDP-0013 registry-actor retracted event: consumers apply kl-005 E.
